verses.original: וַנֵּ֣פֶן וַנַּ֔עַל דֶּ֖רֶךְ הַבָּשָׁ֑ן וַיֵּצֵ֣א עוֹג֩ מֶֽלֶךְ־ הַבָּשָׁ֨ן לִקְרָאתֵ֜נוּ ה֧וּא וְכָל־ עַמּ֛וֹ לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה אֶדְרֶֽעִי׃
verses.transliteration: wan·nê·p̄en wan·na·‘al de·reḵ hab·bā·šān way·yê·ṣê ‘ō·wḡ me·leḵ- hab·bā·šān liq·rā·ṯê·nū hū wə·ḵāl ‘am·mōw lam·mil·ḥā·māh ’eḏ·re·‘î
verses.literal: Then we turned and went up the road to Bashan and Og king of Bashan . . . and his whole army came out to meet us in battle at Edrei
verses.literalPt: DEPOIS nos viramos e subimos o caminho de Basã; e Ogue, rei de Basã, nos saiu ao encontro, ele e todo o seu povo, à peleja em Edrei.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֤ה אֵלַי֙ אַל־ תִּירָ֣א אֹת֔וֹ כִּ֣י בְיָדְךָ֞ נָתַ֧תִּי אֹת֛וֹ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ עַמּ֖וֹ וְאֶת־ אַרְצ֑וֹ וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ לּ֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֗יתָ לְסִיחֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָֽאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּחֶשְׁבּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lay ’al- tî·rā ’ō·ṯōw kî ḇə·yā·ḏə·ḵā nā·ṯat·tî ’ō·ṯōw wə·’eṯ- kāl- ‘am·mōw wə·’eṯ- ’ar·ṣōw wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā lōw ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·ṯā lə·sî·ḥōn me·leḵ hā·’ĕ·mō·rî ’ă·šer yō·wō·šêḇ bə·ḥeš·bō·wn
verses.literal: But the LORD said to me Do not fear him for I have delivered him into your hand along with all his people and his land Do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites who lived in Heshbon
verses.literalPt: Então o SENHOR me disse: Não o temas, porque a ele e a todo o seu povo, e a sua terra, tenho dado na tua mão; e far-lhe-ás como fizeste a Siom, rei dos amorreus, que habitava em Hesbom.

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּן֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵ֜ינוּ בְּיָדֵ֗נוּ גַּ֛ם אֶת־ ע֥וֹג מֶֽלֶךְ־ הַבָּשָׁ֖ן וְאֶת־ כָּל־ עַמּ֑וֹ וַנַּכֵּ֕הוּ עַד־ בִּלְתִּ֥י הִשְׁאִֽיר־ ל֖וֹ שָׂרִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū bə·yā·ḏê·nū gam ’eṯ- ‘ō·wḡ me·leḵ- hab·bā·šān wə·’eṯ- kāl- ‘am·mōw wan·nak·kê·hū ‘aḏ- bil·tî hiš·’îr- lōw śā·rîḏ
verses.literal: So the LORD our God also delivered Og king of Bashan and his whole army into our hands We struck them down until no survivor was left
verses.literalPt: E também o SENHOR nosso Deus nos deu na nossa mão a Ogue, rei de Basã, e a todo o seu povo; de maneira que o ferimos até que não lhe ficou sobrevivente algum.

verses.original: וַנִּלְכֹּ֤ד אֶת־ כָּל־ עָרָיו֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔וא לֹ֤א הָֽיְתָה֙ קִרְיָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ לָקַ֖חְנוּ מֵֽאִתָּ֑ם שִׁשִּׁ֥ים עִיר֙ כָּל־ חֶ֣בֶל אַרְגֹּ֔ב מַמְלֶ֥כֶת ע֖וֹג בַּבָּשָֽׁן׃
verses.transliteration: wan·nil·kōḏ ’eṯ- kāl- ‘ā·rāw bā·‘êṯ ha·hi·w lō hā·yə·ṯāh qir·yāh ’ă·šer lō- lā·qaḥ·nū mê·’it·tām šiš·šîm ‘îr kāl- ḥe·ḇel ’ar·gōḇ mam·le·ḵeṯ ‘ō·wḡ bab·bā·šān
verses.literal: At that time we captured all sixty of his cities There was not . . . a single city we failed to take the entire region of Argob the kingdom of Og in Bashan
verses.literalPt: E naquele tempo tomamos todas as suas cidades; nenhuma cidade houve que lhes não tomássemos; sessenta cidades, toda a região de Argobe, o reino de Ogue em Basã.

verses.original: כָּל־ אֵ֜לֶּה עָרִ֧ים בְּצֻר֛וֹת חוֹמָ֥ה גְבֹהָ֖ה דְּלָתַ֣יִם וּבְרִ֑יחַ לְבַ֛ד מֵעָרֵ֥י הַפְּרָזִ֖י הַרְבֵּ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ’êl·leh ‘ā·rîm bə·ṣu·rō·wṯ ḥō·w·māh ḡə·ḇō·hāh də·lā·ṯa·yim ū·ḇə·rî·aḥ lə·ḇaḏ mê·‘ā·rê hap·pə·rā·zî har·bêh mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: All these cities were fortified with high walls and gates and bars and there were . . . many more . . . unwalled villages
verses.literalPt: Todas estas cidades eram fortificadas com altos muros, portas e ferrolhos; e muitas outras cidades sem muros.

verses.original: וַנַּחֲרֵ֣ם אוֹתָ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔ינוּ לְסִיחֹ֖ן מֶ֣לֶךְ חֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן הַחֲרֵם֙ כָּל־ עִ֣יר מְתִ֔ם הַנָּשִׁ֖ים וְהַטָּֽף׃
verses.transliteration: wan·na·ḥă·rêm ’ō·w·ṯām ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·nū lə·sî·ḥōn me·leḵ ḥeš·bō·wn ha·ḥă·rêm kāl- ‘îr mə·ṯim han·nā·šîm wə·haṭ·ṭāp̄
verses.literal: We devoted them to destruction as we had done to Sihon king of Heshbon utterly destroying the men women and children of every city
verses.literalPt: E destruímo-las como fizemos a Siom, rei de Hesbom, destruindo todas as cidades, homens, mulheres e crianças.

verses.original: וְכָל־ הַבְּהֵמָ֛ה וּשְׁלַ֥ל הֶעָרִ֖ים בַּזּ֥וֹנוּ לָֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl hab·bə·hê·māh ū·šə·lal he·‘ā·rîm baz·zō·w·nū lā·nū
verses.literal: But all the livestock and plunder of the cities we carried off for ourselves
verses.literalPt: Porém todo o gado, e o despojo das cidades, tomamos para nós por presa.

verses.original: וַנִּקַּ֞ח בָּעֵ֤ת הַהִוא֙ אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ מִיַּ֗ד שְׁנֵי֙ מַלְכֵ֣י הָאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּעֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן מִנַּ֥חַל אַרְנֹ֖ן עַד־ הַ֥ר חֶרְמֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wan·niq·qaḥ bā·‘êṯ ha·hi·w ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ mî·yaḏ šə·nê mal·ḵê hā·’ĕ·mō·rî ’ă·šer bə·‘ê·ḇer hay·yar·dên min·na·ḥal ’ar·nōn ‘aḏ- har ḥer·mō·wn
verses.literal: At that time we took from the two kings of the Amorites the land across the Jordan from the Arnon Valley as far as Mount Hermon
verses.literalPt: Assim naquele tempo tomamos a terra das mãos daqueles dois reis dos amorreus, que estavam além do Jordão; desde o rio de Arnom, até ao monte de Hermom

verses.original: צִידֹנִ֛ים יִקְרְא֥וּ לְחֶרְמ֖וֹן שִׂרְיֹ֑ן וְהָ֣אֱמֹרִ֔י יִקְרְאוּ־ ל֖וֹ שְׂנִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: ṣî·ḏō·nîm yiq·rə·’ū lə·ḥer·mō·wn śir·yōn wə·hā·’ĕ·mō·rî yiq·rə·’ū- lōw śə·nîr
verses.literal: which the Sidonians call . . . Sirion but the Amorites call Senir
verses.literalPt: (A Hermom os sidônios chamam Siriom; porém os amorreus o chamam Senir);

verses.original: כֹּ֣ל׀ עָרֵ֣י הַמִּישֹׁ֗ר וְכָל־ הַגִּלְעָד֙ וְכָל־ הַבָּשָׁ֔ן עַד־ סַלְכָ֖ה וְאֶדְרֶ֑עִי עָרֵ֛י מַמְלֶ֥כֶת ע֖וֹג בַּבָּשָֽׁן׃
verses.transliteration: kōl ‘ā·rê ham·mî·šōr wə·ḵāl hag·gil·‘āḏ wə·ḵāl hab·bā·šān ‘aḏ- sal·ḵāh wə·’eḏ·re·‘î ‘ā·rê mam·le·ḵeṯ ‘ō·wḡ bab·bā·šān
verses.literal: all the cities of the plateau all of Gilead and all of Bashan as far as the cities of Salecah and Edrei in the kingdom of Og
verses.literalPt: Todas as cidades do planalto, e todo o Gileade, e todo o Basã, até Salcá e Edrei, cidades do reino de Ogue em Basã.

verses.original: כִּ֣י רַק־ ע֞וֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַבָּשָׁ֗ן נִשְׁאַר֮ מִיֶּ֣תֶר הָרְפָאִים֒ הִנֵּ֤ה עַרְשׂוֹ֙ עֶ֣רֶשׂ בַּרְזֶ֔ל הֲלֹ֣ה הִ֔וא בְּרַבַּ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן תֵּ֧שַׁע אַמּ֣וֹת אָרְכָּ֗הּ וְאַרְבַּ֥ע אַמּ֛וֹת רָחְבָּ֖הּ בְּאַמַּת־ אִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: kî raq- ‘ō·wḡ me·leḵ hab·bā·šān niš·’ar mî·ye·ṯer hā·rə·p̄ā·’îm hin·nêh ‘ar·śōw ‘e·reś bar·zel hă·lōh hî bə·rab·baṯ bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn tê·ša‘ ’am·mō·wṯ ’ā·rə·kāh wə·’ar·ba‘ ’am·mō·wṯ rā·ḥə·bāh bə·’am·maṯ- ’îš
verses.literal: For only Og king of Bashan had remained of the remnant of the Rephaim . . . His bed . . . of iron nine cubits long and four cubits wide - is still in Rabbah of the Ammonites . . .
verses.literalPt: Porque só Ogue, o rei de Basã, restou dos gigantes; eis que o seu leito, um leito de ferro, não está porventura em Rabá dos filhos de Amom? De nove côvados, o seu comprimento, e de quatro côvados, a sua largura, pelo côvado comum.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הָאָ֧רֶץ הַזֹּ֛את יָרַ֖שְׁנוּ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֑וא מֵעֲרֹעֵ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־ עַל־ נַ֣חַל אַרְנֹ֗ן וַחֲצִ֤י הַֽר־ הַגִּלְעָד֙ וְעָרָ֔יו נָתַ֕תִּי לָרֻֽאוּבֵנִ֖י וְלַגָּדִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ yā·raš·nū bā·‘êṯ ha·hi·w mê·‘ă·rō·‘êr ’ă·šer- ‘al- na·ḥal ’ar·nōn wa·ḥă·ṣî har- hag·gil·‘āḏ wə·‘ā·rāw nā·ṯat·tî lå̄·ru·ʾū·ḇē·nī wə·lag·gā·ḏî
verses.literal: So at that time we took possession of this land To the Reubenites and Gadites I gave the land beyond Aroer along the Arnon Valley and half the hill country of Gilead along with its cities
verses.literalPt: Tomamos, pois, esta terra em possessão naquele tempo: Desde Aroer, que está junto ao ribeiro de Arnom, e a metade da montanha de Gileade, com as suas cidades, tenho dado aos rubenitas e gaditas.

verses.original: וְיֶ֨תֶר הַגִּלְעָ֤ד וְכָל־ הַבָּשָׁן֙ מַמְלֶ֣כֶת ע֔וֹג נָתַ֕תִּי לַחֲצִ֖י שֵׁ֣בֶט הַֽמְנַשֶּׁ֑ה כֹּ֣ל חֶ֤בֶל הָֽאַרְגֹּב֙ לְכָל־ הַבָּשָׁ֔ן הַה֥וּא יִקָּרֵ֖א אֶ֥רֶץ רְפָאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ye·ṯer hag·gil·‘āḏ wə·ḵāl hab·bā·šān mam·le·ḵeṯ ‘ō·wḡ nā·ṯat·tî la·ḥă·ṣî šê·ḇeṭ ham·naš·šeh kōl ḥe·ḇel hā·’ar·gōḇ lə·ḵāl hab·bā·šān ha·hū yiq·qā·rê ’e·reṣ rə·p̄ā·’îm
verses.literal: To the half-tribe . . . of Manasseh I gave the rest of Gilead and all of Bashan the kingdom of Og The entire region of Argob the whole territory of Bashan . . . used to be called the land of the Rephaim
verses.literalPt: E o restante de Gileade, como também todo o Basã, o reino de Ogue, dei à meia tribo de Manassés; toda aquela região de Argobe, por todo o Basã, se chamava a terra dos gigantes.

verses.original: יָאִ֣יר בֶּן־ מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה לָקַח֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ חֶ֣בֶל אַרְגֹּ֔ב עַד־ גְּב֥וּל הַגְּשׁוּרִ֖י וְהַמַּֽעֲכָתִ֑י וַיִּקְרָא֩ אֹתָ֨ם עַל־ שְׁמ֤וֹ אֶת־ הַבָּשָׁן֙ חַוֺּ֣ת יָאִ֔יר עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: yā·’îr ben- mə·naš·šeh lā·qaḥ ’eṯ- kāl- ḥe·ḇel ’ar·gōḇ ‘aḏ- gə·ḇūl hag·gə·šū·rî wə·ham·ma·‘ă·ḵā·ṯî way·yiq·rā ’ō·ṯām ‘al- šə·mōw ’eṯ- hab·bā·šān ḥaw·wōṯ yā·’îr ‘aḏ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: Jair a descendant of Manasseh took the whole region of Argob as far as the border of the Geshurites and Maacathites He renamed Bashan . . . after himself Havvoth-jair by which it is called to this day
verses.literalPt: Jair, filho de Manassés, alcançou toda a região de Argobe, até ao termo dos gesuritas, e maacatitas, e a chamou de seu nome, Havote-Jair até este dia.

verses.original: וּלְמָכִ֖יר נָתַ֥תִּי אֶת־ הַגִּלְעָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·mā·ḵîr nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- hag·gil·‘āḏ
verses.literal: To Machir I gave Gilead
verses.literalPt: E a Maquir dei Gileade.

verses.original: וְלָרֻאוּבֵנִ֨י וְלַגָּדִ֜י נָתַ֤תִּי מִן־ הַגִּלְעָד֙ וְעַד־ נַ֣חַל אַרְנֹ֔ן תּ֥וֹךְ הַנַּ֖חַל וּגְבֻ֑ל וְעַד֙ יַבֹּ֣ק הַנַּ֔חַל גְּב֖וּל בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lå̄·ru·ʾū·ḇē·nī wə·lag·gā·ḏî nā·ṯat·tî min- hag·gil·‘āḏ wə·‘aḏ- na·ḥal ’ar·nōn tō·wḵ han·na·ḥal ū·ḡə·ḇul wə·‘aḏ yab·bōq han·na·ḥal gə·ḇūl bə·nê ‘am·mō·wn
verses.literal: and to the Reubenites and Gadites I gave the territory from Gilead to the Arnon Valley (the middle of the valley was the border and up to the Jabbok River the border of the Ammonites . . .
verses.literalPt: Mas aos rubenitas e gaditas dei desde Gileade até ao ribeiro de Arnom, cujo meio serve de limite; e até ao ribeiro de Jaboque, o termo dos filhos de Amom.

verses.original: וְהָֽעֲרָבָ֖ה וְהַיַּרְדֵּ֣ן וּגְבֻ֑ל מִכִּנֶּ֗רֶת וְעַ֨ד יָ֤ם הָֽעֲרָבָה֙ יָ֣ם הַמֶּ֔לַח תַּ֛חַת אַשְׁדֹּ֥ת הַפִּסְגָּ֖ה מִזְרָֽחָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·‘ă·rā·ḇāh wə·hay·yar·dên ū·ḡə·ḇul mik·kin·ne·reṯ wə·‘aḏ yām hā·‘ă·rā·ḇāh yām ham·me·laḥ ta·ḥaṯ ’aš·dōṯ hap·pis·gāh miz·rā·ḥāh
verses.literal: The Jordan River in the Arabah bordered it from Chinnereth to the Sea of the Arabah (the Salt Sea . . . with the slopes of Pisgah to the east
verses.literalPt: Como também a campina, e o Jordão por termo; desde Quinerete até ao mar da campina, o Mar Salgado, abaixo de Asdote-Pisga para o oriente.

verses.original: וָאֲצַ֣ו אֶתְכֶ֔ם בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִ֖וא לֵאמֹ֑ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֗ם נָתַ֨ן לָכֶ֜ם אֶת־ הָאָ֤רֶץ הַזֹּאת֙ לְרִשְׁתָּ֔הּ חֲלוּצִ֣ים תַּֽעַבְר֗וּ לִפְנֵ֛י אֲחֵיכֶ֥ם בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כָּל־ בְּנֵי־ חָֽיִל׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ă·ṣaw ’eṯ·ḵem bā·‘êṯ ha·hi·w lê·mōr Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem nā·ṯan lā·ḵem ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ lə·riš·tāh ḥă·lū·ṣîm ta·‘aḇ·rū lip̄·nê ’ă·ḥê·ḵem bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl kāl- bə·nê- ḥā·yil
verses.literal: At that . . . time I commanded you The LORD your God has given you this land to possess All your men of valor are to cross over armed for battle ahead of your brothers the Israelites . . .
verses.literalPt: E no mesmo tempo vos ordenei, dizendo: O SENHOR vosso Deus vos deu esta terra, para possuí-la; passai, pois, armados vós, todos os homens valentes, diante de vossos irmãos, os filhos de Israel.

verses.original: רַ֠ק נְשֵׁיכֶ֣ם וְטַפְּכֶם֮ וּמִקְנֵכֶם֒ יָדַ֕עְתִּי כִּֽי־ מִקְנֶ֥ה רַ֖ב לָכֶ֑ם יֵֽשְׁבוּ֙ בְּעָ֣רֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: raq nə·šê·ḵem wə·ṭap·pə·ḵem ū·miq·nê·ḵem yā·ḏa‘·tî kî- miq·neh raḇ lā·ḵem yê·šə·ḇū bə·‘ā·rê·ḵem ’ă·šer nā·ṯat·tî lā·ḵem
verses.literal: But your wives your children and your livestock I know that you have much livestock may remain in the cities I have given you
verses.literalPt: Tão-somente vossas mulheres, e vossas crianças, e vosso gado (porque eu sei que tendes muito gado), ficarão nas vossas cidades, que já vos tenho dado.

verses.original: עַ֠ד אֲשֶׁר־ יָנִ֨יחַ יְהוָ֥ה׀ לַֽאֲחֵיכֶם֮ כָּכֶם֒ וְיָרְשׁ֣וּ גַם־ הֵ֔ם אֶת־ הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֛ם נֹתֵ֥ן לָהֶ֖ם בְּעֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְשַׁבְתֶּ֗ם אִ֚ישׁ לִֽירֻשָּׁת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ ’ă·šer- yā·nî·aḥ Yah·weh la·’ă·ḥê·ḵem kā·ḵem wə·yā·rə·šū ḡam- hêm ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem nō·ṯên lā·hem bə·‘ê·ḇer hay·yar·dên wə·šaḇ·tem ’îš lî·ruš·šā·ṯōw ’ă·šer nā·ṯat·tî lā·ḵem
verses.literal: until the LORD gives rest to your brothers as He has to you and they too have taken possession of the land that the LORD your God is giving them across the Jordan Then each of you may return to the possession I have given you
verses.literalPt: Até que o SENHOR dê descanso a vossos irmãos como a vós; para que eles herdem também a terra que o SENHOR vosso Deus lhes há de dar além do Jordão; então voltareis cada qual à sua herança que já vos tenho dado.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ יְהוֹשׁ֣וּעַ צִוֵּ֔יתִי בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִ֖וא לֵאמֹ֑ר עֵינֶ֣יךָ הָרֹאֹ֗ת אֵת֩ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֜ה יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם֙ לִשְׁנֵי֙ הַמְּלָכִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה כֵּֽן־ יַעֲשֶׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לְכָל־ הַמַּמְלָכ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֖ה עֹבֵ֥ר שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- yə·hō·wō·šū·a‘ ṣiw·wê·ṯî bā·‘êṯ ha·hi·w lê·mōr ‘ê·ne·ḵā hā·rō·’ōṯ ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem liš·nê ham·mə·lā·ḵîm hā·’êl·leh kên- ya·‘ă·śeh Yah·weh lə·ḵāl ham·mam·lā·ḵō·wṯ ’ă·šer ’at·tāh ‘ō·ḇêr šām·māh
verses.literal: And at that . . . time I commanded Joshua Your own eyes have seen all that the LORD your God has done to these two kings The LORD will do the same to all the kingdoms you are about to enter . . .
verses.literalPt: Também dei ordem a Josué no mesmo tempo, dizendo: Os teus olhos têm visto tudo o que o SENHOR vosso Deus tem feito a estes dois reis; assim fará o SENHOR a todos os reinos, a que tu passarás.

verses.original: לֹ֖א תְִּירָא֑וּם כִּ֚י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם ה֖וּא הַנִּלְחָ֥ם לָכֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: lō tī·rå̄·ʾūm kî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem hū han·nil·ḥām lā·ḵem
verses.literal: Do not be afraid of them for the LORD your God Himself will fight for you
verses.literalPt: Não os temais, porque o SENHOR vosso Deus é o que peleja por vós.

verses.original: וָאֶתְחַנַּ֖ן אֶל־ יְהוָ֑ה בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִ֖וא לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eṯ·ḥan·nan ’el- Yah·weh bā·‘êṯ ha·hi·w lê·mōr
verses.literal: At that . . . time I also pleaded . . . with the LORD
verses.literalPt: Também eu pedi graça ao SENHOR no mesmo tempo, dizendo:

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה אַתָּ֤ה הַֽחִלּ֙וֹתָ֙ לְהַרְא֣וֹת אֶֽת־ עַבְדְּךָ֔ אֶ֨ת־ גָּדְלְךָ֔ וְאֶת־ יָדְךָ֖ הַחֲזָקָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר מִי־ אֵל֙ בַּשָּׁמַ֣יִם וּבָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה כְמַעֲשֶׂ֖יךָ וְכִגְבוּרֹתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’at·tāh ha·ḥil·lō·w·ṯā lə·har·’ō·wṯ ’eṯ- ‘aḇ·də·ḵā ’eṯ- gā·ḏə·lə·ḵā wə·’eṯ- yā·ḏə·ḵā ha·ḥă·zā·qāh ’ă·šer mî- ’êl baš·šā·ma·yim ū·ḇā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- ya·‘ă·śeh ḵə·ma·‘ă·śe·ḵā wə·ḵiḡ·ḇū·rō·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: O Lord GOD You have begun to show Your greatness and power . . . to Your servant For what god in heaven or on earth can perform such works and mighty acts as Yours
verses.literalPt: Senhor DEUS! já começaste a mostrar ao teu servo a tua grandeza e a tua forte mão; pois, que Deus há nos céus e na terra, que possa fazer segundo as tuas obras, e segundo os teus grandes feitos?

verses.original: אֶעְבְּרָה־ נָּ֗א וְאֶרְאֶה֙ אֶת־ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַטּוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּעֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן הָהָ֥ר הַטּ֛וֹב הַזֶּ֖ה וְהַלְּבָנֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ’e‘·bə·rāh- nā wə·’er·’eh ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ haṭ·ṭō·w·ḇāh ’ă·šer bə·‘ê·ḇer hay·yar·dên hā·hār haṭ·ṭō·wḇ haz·zeh wə·hal·lə·ḇā·nō·wn
verses.literal: Please let me cross over and see the good land beyond the Jordan that pleasant hill country as well as Lebanon
verses.literalPt: Rogo-te que me deixes passar, para que veja esta boa terra que está além do Jordão; esta boa montanha, e o Líbano!

verses.original: וַיִּתְעַבֵּ֨ר יְהוָ֥ה בִּי֙ לְמַ֣עַנְכֶ֔ם וְלֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖ע אֵלָ֑י וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֤ה אֵלַי֙ רַב־ לָ֔ךְ אַל־ תּ֗וֹסֶף דַּבֵּ֥ר אֵלַ֛י ע֖וֹד בַּדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·‘ab·bêr Yah·weh bî lə·ma·‘an·ḵem wə·lō šā·ma‘ ’ê·lāy way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lay raḇ- lāḵ ’al- tō·w·sep̄ dab·bêr ’ê·lay ‘ō·wḏ bad·dā·ḇār haz·zeh
verses.literal: But the LORD was angry with me on account of you and He would not listen to me That is enough the LORD said to me Do not speak to Me again about this matter
verses.literalPt: Porém o SENHOR indignou-se muito contra mim por causa de vós, e não me ouviu; antes o SENHOR me disse: Basta; não me fales mais deste assunto;

verses.original: עֲלֵ֣ה׀ רֹ֣אשׁ הַפִּסְגָּ֗ה וְשָׂ֥א עֵינֶ֛יךָ יָ֧מָּה וְצָפֹ֛נָה וְתֵימָ֥נָה וּמִזְרָ֖חָה וּרְאֵ֣ה בְעֵינֶ֑יךָ כִּי־ לֹ֥א תַעֲבֹ֖ר אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֥ן הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·lêh rōš hap·pis·gāh wə·śā ‘ê·ne·ḵā yām·māh wə·ṣā·p̄ō·nāh wə·ṯê·mā·nāh ū·miz·rā·ḥāh ū·rə·’êh ḇə·‘ê·ne·ḵā kî- lō ṯa·‘ă·ḇōr ’eṯ- hay·yar·dên haz·zeh
verses.literal: Go to the top of Pisgah and look . . . to the west and north and south and east See the land with your own eyes for you will not cross this Jordan
verses.literalPt: Sobe ao cume de Pisga, e levanta os teus olhos ao ocidente, e ao norte, e ao sul, e ao oriente, e vê com os teus olhos; porque não passarás este Jordão.

verses.original: וְצַ֥ו אֶת־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ וְחַזְּקֵ֣הוּ וְאַמְּצֵ֑הוּ כִּי־ ה֣וּא יַעֲבֹ֗ר לִפְנֵי֙ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה וְהוּא֙ יַנְחִ֣יל אוֹתָ֔ם אֶת־ הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṣaw ’eṯ- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ wə·ḥaz·zə·qê·hū wə·’am·mə·ṣê·hū kî- hū ya·‘ă·ḇōr lip̄·nê hā·‘ām haz·zeh wə·hū yan·ḥîl ’ō·w·ṯām ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer tir·’eh
verses.literal: But commission Joshua encourage him and strengthen him for he will cross over ahead of the . . . people and enable them to inherit - the land that you will see
verses.literalPt: Manda, pois, a Josué, e anima-o, e fortalece-o; porque ele passará adiante deste povo, e o fará possuir a terra que verás.

verses.original: וַנֵּ֣שֶׁב בַּגָּ֔יְא מ֖וּל בֵּ֥ית פְּעֽוֹר׃פ
verses.transliteration: wan·nê·šeḇ bag·gāy mūl bêṯ pə·‘ō·wr
verses.literal: So we stayed in the valley opposite Beth-peor
verses.literalPt: Assim ficamos neste vale, defronte de Bete-Peor.
